$comment: Golden cases of the render test page (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py), in the two modern palettes: every feature the renderers draw, the effect cells first (P13). no-effects is a device without effects (nuitool snap --no-effects: no filter, mask, backdrop blur or shadow, each gradient one flat color, and an element with a box-shadow loses its background and border, which RmlUi draws into the shadow's texture); reduced-effects is the player's setting (filters, masks and the backdrop blur off; the shadow and the gradients stay).
